verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents load balancing across multiple LLM models and dynamic request routing. Neither of these is an automatic retry policy for transient provider errors. No item mentions retries, retry counts, backoff, or failover on provider errors, so the capability has no evidence here and the axis, which clearly applies to an AI gateway, scores none.
